hypotheses.justification: The coefficient bound at index 0 gives ‖g.coeff 0 - f.coeff 0‖ < ε, while a norm is nonnegative; hence 0 < ε follows from hcoeff. After deleting hε, derive it this way and use it in the proof. This also shows the coefficient-bound hypotheses cannot hold in the degenerate case ε ≤ 0.
